params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return. Defaults to `20`, max `200`.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of results to skip before starting to collect the result set. Defaults to `0`.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort order for `submitted_at` (`asc` for ascending, `desc` for descending). Defaults to `desc`.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Filter by one or more event IDs (e.g. `?event_id=123` or `?event_id[]=123&event_id[]=456`).

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by submission status. `active` returns the most recent submission per supplier (default). `inactive` returns previous-round submissions that have been superseded. Pass both to include all (e.g. `?status=active` or `?status[]=active&status[]=inactive`).

params.name: archived
params.description: Filter by archived state. Archived submissions are ones that have been removed from consideration in the event by the buyer. Pass both to include all (e.g. `?archived[]=true&archived[]=false`).

params.name: submitted_at_gte
params.description: Filter submissions submitted on or after this date. Accepts ISO 8601 format (`YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`).

params.name: submitted_at_lte
params.description: Filter submissions submitted on or before this date. Accepts ISO 8601 format (`YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`).

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of quote submissions. Submissions from suppliers that have been excluded from an event are not returned.
Get a quote submission by id
